The spirit of our table

A slower meal.
A warmer welcome.

Ember & Olive is a restaurant concept built around the best part of eating: sharing it. Think vegetables kissed by the grill, bread for the last of the sauce, and conversations that outlast dessert.

Come for a quiet dinner for two. Stay for another story.
